nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Central module crate defining all embedder-facing types including viewport geometry, cursor management, embedder messaging, media session, permissions, web resource requests, JavaScript evaluation, notifications, and webview management.

nodes.name: WebViewPoint
nodes.summary: Describes a point in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with conversion methods.

nodes.name: WebViewRect
nodes.summary: Describes a rectangle in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: WebViewVector
nodes.summary: Describes a 2D vector in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: Scroll
nodes.summary: Enum of scroll operations: delta offset, scroll to start, or scroll to end.

nodes.name: ShutdownState
nodes.summary: Tracks whether Servo is not shutting down, in progress, or has finished shutting down.

nodes.name: Cursor
nodes.summary: Large enum of all standard cursor types including resize cursors, grab, pointer, text, zoom, and more.

nodes.name: EventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to implement, allowing Servo to request the main event loop be woken up for message processing.

nodes.name: GenericEmbedderProxy
nodes.summary: Generic sender paired with an event loop waker for dispatching messages to the embedder and waking its event loop.

nodes.name: RefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to drive animation frame scheduling, e.g. via Vsync notifications.

nodes.name: AuthenticationResponse
nodes.summary: Credentials for HTTP authentication challenges with username and password fields.

nodes.name: AllowOrDeny
nodes.summary: Simple enum for binary allow/deny responses to permission requests.

nodes.name: RegisterOrUnregister
nodes.summary: Simple enum indicating whether a protocol handler should be registered or unregistered.

nodes.name: ProtocolHandlerUpdateRegistration
nodes.summary: Represents a request to register or unregister a custom protocol handler for a URL scheme.

nodes.name: ViewportDetails
nodes.summary: Viewport size and HiDPI scale factor for rendering WebView contents.

nodes.name: ScreenMetrics
nodes.summary: Screen size and available size in device-independent pixels for DOM Screen API usage.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.summary: Enum of pixel buffer formats: K8, KA8, RGB8, RGBA8, and BGRA8.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: A raster image buffer with width, height, pixel format, and shared memory backing for pixel data.

nodes.name: ConsoleLogLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of console API message severity levels: Log, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Trace, Dir.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceDescription
nodes.summary: Address and human-readable name for a discovered Bluetooth device.

nodes.name: EmbedderMsg
nodes.summary: Central enum of all messages sent from Servo to the embedder, covering 25+ message types including status, clipboard, cursor, media session, permissions, web resource interception, accessibility, and devtools.
nodes.languageNotes: Large enum with variants carrying WebViewId, GenericSender callbacks, and domain-specific payloads for bidirectional process communication.

nodes.name: MediaMetadata
nodes.summary: Media session metadata: title, artist, and album strings for media notifications.

nodes.name: MediaSessionPlaybackState
nodes.summary: Enum of media session playback states: None, Playing, Paused.

nodes.name: MediaPositionState
nodes.summary: Media playback position state with duration, playback rate, and current position.

nodes.name: MediaSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of media session events: SetMetadata, PlaybackStateChange, SetPositionState.

nodes.name: PermissionFeature
nodes.summary: Enum of permission features matching the DOM PermissionName enum including geolocation, notifications, camera, microphone, bluetooth, screen wake lock, and gamepad.

nodes.name: InputMethodType
nodes.summary: Enum of input method editor types appropriate for editing HTML input fields: color, date, email, number, password, text, url, etc.

nodes.name: DualRumbleEffectParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for dual-rumble gamepad haptic effects: duration, start delay, strong and weak magnitude.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectType
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad haptic effect types, currently only DualRumble with parameters.

nodes.name: WebResourceRequest
nodes.summary: Details of a web resource request including method, headers, URL, destination, referrer, and flags for main frame and redirect status.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponseMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of messages for web resource interception: Start with response, SendBodyData, FinishLoad, CancelLoad, and DoNotIntercept.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponse
nodes.summary: HTTP response data for intercepted web resources: URL, headers, status code, and status message.

nodes.name: Theme
nodes.summary: Enum of platform theme: Light or Dark.

nodes.name: MediaSessionActionType
nodes.summary: Enum of media session action types: Play, Pause, SeekBackward, SeekForward, PreviousTrack, NextTrack, SkipAd, Stop, and SeekTo.

nodes.name: LoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of web page load states: Started, HeadParsed, Complete.

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Desktop notification data including title, body, tag, language, silent flag, icon/badge/image URLs with associated raster resources, and action buttons.

nodes.name: NotificationAction
nodes.summary: Action button for a desktop notification: name, title, icon URL, and icon raster resource.

nodes.name: ScreenGeometry
nodes.summary: Screen size, available size, and window rectangle in device pixels for CSSOM Screen APIs and window position queries.

nodes.name: PaintHitTestResult
nodes.summary: Result of a paint hit test containing the pipeline ID, viewport point, and external scroll ID.

nodes.name: AnimationState
nodes.summary: Enum of animation state combinations: whether animations and animation callbacks are present or absent.

nodes.name: JSValue
nodes.summary: Enum of JavaScript values that can be serialized across the process boundary: Undefined, Null, Boolean, Number, String, Element, ShadowRoot, Frame, Window, Array, Object.

nodes.name: JavaScriptErrorInfo
nodes.summary: Detailed JavaScript error information: message, filename, stack trace, line number, and column.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationResultSerializationError
nodes.summary: Error enum for failures during JavaScript result serialization: detached shadow root, stale element, unknown type, or other errors.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationError
nodes.summary: Error enum for JavaScript evaluation failures including document not found, compilation failure, evaluation failure, internal error, webview not ready, and serialization error.

nodes.name: ScreenshotCaptureError
nodes.summary: Error enum for screenshot capture failures: could not read image or webview does not exist.

nodes.name: RgbColor
nodes.summary: Simple RGB color value with red, green, and blue byte fields.

nodes.name: ScriptToEmbedderChan
nodes.summary: Wraps a GenericCallback for sending EmbedderMsg from the script thread to the embedder with event loop waking.

nodes.name: NewWebViewDetails
nodes.summary: Details for communicating a new WebView created by the embedder back to the constellation: ID, viewport details, and user content manager ID.

nodes.name: UrlRequest
nodes.summary: A customizable URL load request with URL and configurable HTTP headers.

nodes.name: WakeLockType
nodes.summary: Enum of wake lock types, currently only Screen.

nodes.name: WakeLockDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for platform-specific wake lock support to prevent the screen from sleeping while a wake lock is held.

nodes.name: as_device_point
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewPoint to DevicePoint by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: as_device_rect
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewRect to DeviceRect by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a LayoutRect to a WebViewRect by constructing a Box2D from CSSPixel points.

nodes.name: as_device_vector
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewVector to DeviceVector2D by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Sends a message through the proxy channel and wakes the embedder event loop, logging warnings on failure.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Clones the GenericEmbedderProxy by cloning its sender and event loop waker.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Image with width, height, shared memory data, byte range, and pixel format.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a ConsoleLogLevel to the equivalent log::Level for integration with the Rust logging facade.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates MediaMetadata with the given title and empty artist and album strings.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MediaPositionState from duration, playback rate, and position values.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebResourceResponse with default empty headers, OK status, and OK status message.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a Theme enum to a PrefersColorScheme for CSS media query evaluation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a ScriptToEmbedderChan wrapping a GenericCallback that forwards EmbedderMsg and wakes the event loop on arrival.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a UrlRequest from a URL with an empty header map.

nodes.name: resources.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Resource enum for embedder-bundled assets and the ResourceReaderMethods trait with a static registration mechanism via inventory crate.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.summary: Enum of all bundled resources: bluetooth blocklist, domain list, HSTS preload, error pages, icons, debugger JS, and JSON viewer HTML.

nodes.name: ResourceReaderMethods
nodes.summary: Trait that embedders implement to provide resource reading with sandbox-aware file access for content processes.

nodes.name: read_bytes
nodes.summary: Reads a named Resource and returns its contents as raw bytes via the registered resource reader.

nodes.name: read_string
nodes.summary: Reads a named Resource and returns its contents as a UTF-8 string.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files
nodes.summary: Returns the list of files that should remain accessible after sandboxing the content process.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files_dirs
nodes.summary: Returns the list of directories that should remain accessible after sandboxing the content process.

nodes.name: filename
nodes.summary: Returns the filename associated with each Resource variant, mapping bluetooth blocklist, error pages, icons, and other assets to their file names.
